mentions.name: Automated Pigeon Deterrent Water Turret
mentions.description: This open-source, automated water turret sprays water to deter pigeons and protect the builder's raspberry plants. The hardware, including the bill of materials, was built with Claude's help, and a demo video is available.
mentions.problem: Pigeons raiding and damaging the raspberry plants.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built an Automated Pigeon Deterrent Water Turret.

Everything has been built with Claude, even the bill of materials for the hardware.

The project is open source and now protects my raspberries.
